product_context: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE: MeetingSprout is an invented meeting scheduler. This is a schema demonstration, not an approved customer study.

method_configuration.single_model: Illustrative only: one fresh model conversation using the shared packet, with output probability_a and an explanation; no customer outcomes.
method_configuration.mirofish: Illustrative only: one isolated simulation using the same packet and fictional assumptions, then an assessed probability_a; record the real source revision, rounds, budget, and settings when designing an actual study.

fictional_persona_assumptions: A fictional visitor who wants to reduce meeting coordination work; no age, gender, country, or personality type assumed.
A fictional visitor concerned about calendar permissions; this concern is an assumption to investigate.

cases.audience: Illustrative first-time visitors seeking a team meeting scheduler.
cases.channel: Illustrative owned landing page; the headline is the only varying content.
cases.eligibility: First eligible unique visitor assignment within the fixed window; exclude previously assigned visitors.
exclusions: Declared automated traffic filter applied identically to both arms

response.definition: At least one completed trial registration in the same session as first exposure, counted once per eligible unique visitor; sessions ending after the fixed observation window are not counted.

cases.sample_size_rationale: Illustrative schema value only. It is not a powered sample-size calculation; set a real minimum and rationale before freezing.
